diagnostics.model: rolling forecast + calibrated net-load quantile + joint procurement/storage MILP
diagnostics.parameter_selection_scope: January-only initialization, then monthly selection using completed historical days
diagnostics.primary_cost_definition: planned purchase cost subject to calibrated quantile floor
diagnostics.week_type_rule: six learned weekday indicators with Sunday as reference; legacy workday split only in warm-up
diagnostics.time_mapping: right endpoint; period 1 is 0:00-0:10 and period 144 is 23:50-24:00

tuning_protocol.update_frequency: first day of each formal month
tuning_protocol.forecast_score: mean price-weighted absolute error per period
tuning_protocol.risk_budget_rule: remaining emergency budget / remaining formal calendar days
tuning_protocol.risk_selection: minimum surrogate cost among historically budget-feasible candidates; otherwise minimum emergency bound
tuning_protocol.reserve_score: actual validation total cost with continuous SOC and identical full-SOC endpoints
tuning_protocol.tie_rule: scores rounded to 8 decimals, then increasing degree/window/quantile/radius
